title: Board Briefing — Funding and Liquidity
subtitle: The position, the issue, the merger and seasonality effects, and the recommended move
confidence_line: 92% of figures current, validated and traceable · Howard University division pending

sections.label: The position
sections.text: Well capitalized at a 9.62% net worth ratio, ≈$1.36B in assets, ≈84,000 members across 13 Maryland branches and the Howard University division.

sections.label: The issue
sections.text: Loan-to-share is near 89% and rising — loans up 6.4% year over year against shares up 3.1%. On-hand liquidity is around 11.2% and drifting.

sections.label: The merger effect
sections.text: Howard University division balances have not fully reconciled into the enterprise totals. The enterprise figure is safe to cite; the consolidated figure is not, yet.

sections.label: The seasonality effect
sections.text: The education field of membership drives a summer deposit drawdown and payroll-cycle inflows. The next favorable inflow window is the timing lever.

sections.label: The recommendation
sections.text: Launch a targeted education-community deposit campaign timed to the fall inflow window, and arrange a standby funding line as a buffer.

recommended_actions.title: Launch the education-community deposit campaign
recommended_actions.description: Target the education field of membership and the newly merged Howard University members, sequenced to land ahead of the fall payroll-cycle inflow window.
recommended_actions.owner_note: Illustrative owner set — pending the ESFCU leadership roster

recommended_actions.title: Arrange the standby funding line
recommended_actions.description: Put a committed facility in place as a buffer so the ratio holds through Q1 even if campaign uptake lands at the low edge of the seasonality band.
recommended_actions.owner_note: Illustrative owner set — pending the ESFCU leadership roster
recommended_actions.timeframe: Board approval at the next meeting

recommended_actions.title: Close the Howard University division reconciliation
recommended_actions.description: Restore the stalled nightly mapping and confirm the consolidated deposit and membership figures before they are cited to the board or an examiner.
